summary: Releases the per-file critical section for file index a1. The section is embedded at offset +12 of a 36-byte record inside the bucket dword_8D4920[a1 >> 5]; the entry within the bucket is selected by a1 & 0x1F. Called from multiple file-I/O sites as the leave half of a guarded per-file access.

operations.description: Compute the per-file critical section address: dword_8D4920[a1 >> 5] + 36 * (a1 & 0x1F) + 12, i.e. bucket = a1/32, record = a1%32, record stride 36 bytes, critical section at record offset +12.
Call LeaveCriticalSection on the computed LPCRITICAL_SECTION to release the lock guarding file index a1.
Invoked from nine file-I/O call sites (sub_58C331, sub_58C724, sub_58C9B4, sub_58E22B, sub_592891, sub_595AF9, sub_595F11, sub_59B650, sub_59B760) as the common leave path after file operations.
